items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Suffers injury setback at practice
items.text:
Coach Sean McVay noted Sunday that Ferguson pulled his hamstring during Friday's practice and will likely be sidelined for another couple of weeks, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: Eight catches in Week 9 win
items.text:
St. Brown brought in eight of 10 targets for 86 yards in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.title: Jahmyr Gibbs: Rush TD in Week 9 win
items.text:
Gibbs rushed 20 times for 74 yards and a touchdown and failed to bring in his only target in the Lions' 19-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Bottled up outside of short TD
items.text:
Barkley rushed 13 times for 22 yards and a touchdown while failing to catch his only target in Sunday's 19-11 loss to the Giants.
